panels.description: Himalayas, 2042, night. Roman hangs half-buried in a blue-white crevasse while his small silver Terrain Jumper descends on articulated legs. Lightning strikes through the glacier and disrupts the sensor housing. Leave the upper-left sky clear for a caption.

Himalayas, 2026, day. Seen from behind six-year-old Sitara on a high stone step, floodwater carries a cooking pot and a child's red sweater past her while an indistinct adult hand pulls her away. Keep faces and cultural details nonspecific. Leave the upper-right clear for a caption.

Antarctica, 2046, day. Vast blue-white ice, warning flags, a dark unstable zone, and a half-buried sensor tripod. Sitara stands lower right beside her separate small silver field TJ; Nayah stands behind and left holding the route line. Leave upper-left clear for a caption and upper-right for a balloon.

Sitara's insulated boot hovers just short of the flagged line. The sensor's red status light blinks beyond it while a geometric tremor advances beneath translucent blue ice. Leave upper-left clear for a balloon and upper-right for a sound effect.
